items.title: I Teach AWS in Japanese.​  Someday, in English.​
items.summary: Lightning talk at "English LT Night" (JAWS-UG Sainokuni Saitama × JAWS-UG Sales).I'm a cloud instructor at Trainocate Japan. I hold all AWS certifications, but my English is still beginner level.In this talk, I share my English experiences at AWS re:Invent 2024 & 2025 (hotel check-in, re:Play, GameDay / Jam), my goal to teach AWS in English to people outside Japan, and my challenge: 10 minutes of English practice every day, and talking with my GameDay / Jam team at re:Invent 2026 without translation apps.This LT is my first step. Let's practice English together in Las Vegas!---JAWS-UG さいたま支部 × JAWS-UG Sales支部「English LT Night」での英語LTです。AWS全冠でも英語は初心者レベルの私が、re:Inventでの英語体験と「いつか英語でAWSを教える」という目標、そしてre:Invent 2026への挑戦を話しました。#jawsug_sainokuni #jawsug_sales
